scheme.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
scheme.implementing_agency: State/UT Governments, District Administration, Gram Panchayats/ULBs
scheme.description: IGNOAPS is a component of NSAP providing monthly pension to BPL senior citizens. Central Government contribution: Rs 200/month for age 60-79 years, Rs 500/month for age 80 years and above. States may add their own top-up contribution. Launched 15 August 1995. Pension disbursed through DBT to Aadhaar-linked bank or post office account.
scheme.voice_summary: The old age pension is for people aged 60 or above from below poverty line families. The central share is 200 rupees a month, and 500 rupees from age 80.
benefits: Rs 200/month old age pension for persons aged 60-79 (Central share)
Rs 500/month old age pension for persons aged 80+ (Central share)
eligibility: Applicant must be aged 60 years or above
Applicant must belong to a household living below the poverty line (BPL)
application_process: offline: Collect IGNOAPS application form from Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office / Municipality.
offline: Attach Aadhaar card, age proof certificate, BPL proof, and bank passbook photocopy.
offline: Submit form to Social Welfare Officer or Block Development Office.
offline: Verification is conducted by local administration before sanction.
online: Visit the official NSAP portal (nsap.nic.in) or your state social welfare department portal.
online: Select 'Apply Online' and choose 'Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)'.
online: Upload age proof document (showing age 60+) and BPL ration card/income certificate.
online: Enter bank account details linked to Aadhaar for Direct Benefit Transfer.
online: Submit application and note down tracking reference number.

benefits.text: Rs 200/month old age pension for persons aged 60-79 (Central share)
Rs 500/month old age pension for persons aged 80+ (Central share)

documents.name: Proof of Age (60+ years)
documents.description: Birth certificate, school certificate, electoral photo identity card (EPIC), or medical officer age certificate

documents.name: BPL Card / Certificate
documents.description: BPL ration card or certificate issued by designated Gram Panchayat / Municipal authority

documents.name: Bank / Post Office Passbook
documents.description: Active single bank or post office savings account passbook with IFSC/branch code

procedure_steps.text: Collect IGNOAPS application form from Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office / Municipality.
Attach Aadhaar card, age proof certificate, BPL proof, and bank passbook photocopy.
Submit form to Social Welfare Officer or Block Development Office.
Verification is conducted by local administration before sanction.
Visit the official NSAP portal (nsap.nic.in) or your state social welfare department portal.
Select 'Apply Online' and choose 'Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)'.
Upload age proof document (showing age 60+) and BPL ration card/income certificate.
Enter bank account details linked to Aadhaar for Direct Benefit Transfer.
Submit application and note down tracking reference number.

catalog_descriptions.en: The old age pension is for people aged 60 or above from below poverty line families. The central share is 200 rupees a month, and 500 rupees from age 80.
catalog_descriptions.hi: वृद्धावस्था पेंशन गरीबी रेखा से नीचे के परिवारों के 60 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के लोगों के लिए है। केंद्रीय हिस्सा 200 रुपये प्रति माह है, और 80 वर्ष की आयु से 500 रुपये है।
catalog_descriptions.ta: முதியோர் ஓய்வூதியம் என்பது வறுமைக் கோட்டிற்குக் கீழே உள்ள குடும்பங்களைச் சேர்ந்த 60 வயது அல்லது அதற்கு மேற்பட்டவர்களுக்கு வழங்கப்படுகிறது. மத்தியப் பங்கு மாதத்திற்கு 200 ரூபாயாகவும், 80 வயதிலிருந்தே 500 ரூபாயாகவும் உள்ளது.
